purpose: Official-source discovery manifest for 17 recent historical post_qualifying candidates; candidate count is not Gold race count.
certification_status: No candidate certified Gold by this manifest.

identifier_basis.local_cross_check_status: Pending: shell helper failed when reading schedule; known 2025 round mappings were used. Local schedule is identity reference only, not historical availability evidence.

audit_policy.feature_scope: Qualifying plus explicitly evidenced roster and circuit identity. Omit optional fields lacking auditable pre-cutoff provenance.
audit_policy.publication_clock: The official registry prints CET. Exact fixed UTC+1 versus colloquial Central European summer time has not been independently established.
audit_policy.pdf_clock: Cover Date and Time carry no timezone. Event-local interpretation is plausible from comparisons but is an inference, not explicit PDF evidence.
audit_policy.qualification_completed: A matching classification issue is a potential completion upper bound after its timezone is established. Scheduled qualifying end is not evidence of actual completion.
audit_policy.version_selection: Resolve every original, revised and recalled required-field document published by cutoff. A current generic URL can point to a later replacement.
audit_policy.availability_proof_limit: Official PDFs and present registry provide printed issue/publication claims observed today. They do not independently prove which bytes were publicly served at a historical instant. Retain raw PDF bytes, hashes and registry snapshots; strengthen with archived release evidence where available.
audit_policy.conservative_timezone_bound: max(UTC under CET, UTC under CEST) can be a conservative release bound if these are the only plausible interpretations. It is not an exact timestamp and cannot satisfy an exact-timestamp Gold contract.
audit_policy.labels: Final race classifications are post-race labels and must never enter pre-race features.
audit_policy.weather: Omitted from Gold Core until actual operational forecast release availability is evidenced.

shared_schedule_source.publication_verification: Official page explicitly prints UTC publication timestamp; this is a source claim observed today, not independent archived-byte proof.
shared_schedule_source.clock_semantics: F1 table says start time. FIA event timetables explicitly define starred race times as formation-lap start; do not silently call these actual lights-out.

weather_research.finding: Model initialization is not public release time. Historical forecast is a stitched series, not retained race-time forecast horizon. Archive run IDs and historical dissemination evidence are required before inclusion.

parsing_rules: Match PDF cover event, year, document number, title and actual enclosed timing table.
Parse qualifying rows by coordinates or validated table columns; retain car number, driver, entrant, Q1/Q2/Q3, laps and missing-value status.
Do not invent numeric qualifying positions for NOT CLASSIFIED or DISQUALIFIED rows.
Do not conflate classification rank with later starting-grid slot. Grid PDFs use spatial two-column ordering.
Capture the exact raw publication and issue strings before deriving timestamps.
Validate event/year in returned registry content because some FIA URL filters appear to be ignored.
Verify original versus replacement bytes and cover metadata even when filenames are identical.
